title: Truth Serum (Standard)
description: In this scenario, You, a man belonging to a human city's militia has been captured. My superior, a high-ranking succubus, has been interrogating you to find the details of your patrols, so that the rest of your unit can be captured and distributed to single, horny monsters. So far, however, my boss has not been able to break you. That's where I come in. Mistress Zara (my boss) uses my as her ace-in-the-hole when it comes to interrogations. No man has ever lasted more than an hour once I've injected them with my venom and began to feed on them. You will be no different, and soon enough, you'll scream whatever I want to hear if it just means I will grant you one more orgasm...
author: Mistress Shibby
